scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai/core build && pnpm --filter @ai/web build && pnpm --filter @ai/api build
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/check-css-colors.mjs && node scripts/check-no-icon-libs.mjs && node scripts/check-control-chars.mjs && node scripts/reference-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/email-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/lms-type-floor.mjs --check && node scripts/check-cohort-hardcodes.mjs && node scripts/check-admin-zone.mjs
scripts.compliance:capture: node scripts/with-env.mjs REFERENCE_ONLY=1 playwright test -c compliance/playwright.config.ts --project=reference --workers=1
scripts.e2e:learn: node scripts/with-env.mjs LEARNER_V2=1 playwright test -c compliance/playwright.config.ts --project=e2e-learn
scripts.e2e:v3: node scripts/with-env.mjs LMS_V3=1 playwright test -c compliance/playwright.config.ts --project=e2e-v3
scripts.harness: node scripts/with-env.mjs REFERENCE_ONLY=1 playwright test -c compliance/playwright.config.ts --project=harness
scripts.compliance:docker: docker run --rm --network host -v $PWD:/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v$(node -p "require('@playwright/test/package.json').version")-noble bash -lc 'corepack enable && pnpm i --frozen-lockfile && pnpm "$@"' --
scripts.parity:admin-r2:refs: npm install --prefix design-reference/admin-redesign-r2 --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund && docker run --rm --network none -v $PWD:/work -w /work -e FONTCONFIG_FILE=/work/design-reference/admin-redesign-r2/harness/fonts.conf -e CHROME=/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble node design-reference/admin-redesign-r2/harness/render-mockup.mjs
